items.exampleEn: The city is building a tunnel under the river so cars can avoid the old bridge.
items.exampleZh: 市政府正在河底下興建一條隧道，讓車子可以避開那座舊橋。

items.exampleEn: Many young families move to the suburbs to find bigger homes.
items.exampleZh: 很多年輕家庭搬到郊區，好找更大的房子。

items.exampleEn: Each company at the job fair had its own booth.
items.exampleZh: 就業博覽會上每家公司都有自己的攤位。

items.exampleEn: Fishermen were selling their morning catch at the dock.
items.exampleZh: 漁夫們在碼頭賣早上捕到的漁獲。

items.exampleEn: The nationwide survey asked ten thousand teachers about their working hours.
items.exampleZh: 這項全國性的調查詢問了一萬名老師的工作時數。

items.exampleEn: The museum keeps its oldest paintings in an underground room.
items.exampleZh: 博物館把最古老的畫作存放在地下室。

items.exampleEn: Guests got lost because the venue was hidden behind a shopping mall.
items.exampleZh: 賓客迷路了，因為會場藏在一間購物中心後面。

items.exampleEn: Turn left at the next intersection, and you will see the bank.
items.exampleZh: 在下一個十字路口左轉，就會看到銀行。

items.exampleEn: The pedestrian stopped to ask me the way to the train station.
items.exampleZh: 那位行人停下來向我問去火車站的路。

items.sentenceEn: Our office is near a busy intersection in the city center.
items.sentenceZh: 我們辦公室在市中心一個繁忙的十字路口附近。

items.audioEn: The concert has moved to a bigger venue, so please check the new address on your ticket.
items.audioZh: 演唱會換到更大的場地了，請看票上的新地址。

items.sentenceEn: We drove through a long tunnel to reach the other side of the hill.
items.sentenceZh: 我們開車穿過一條長隧道，到了山的另一邊。

items.sentenceEn: In London, many people take the underground to work every day.
items.sentenceZh: 在倫敦，很多人每天搭地鐵上班。

items.stemEn: The ship stayed at the ____ for two days while workers unloaded the boxes.
items.stemZh: 工人卸下箱子的那兩天，船一直停在碼頭。

items.stemEn: The new rule will apply ____, not just in the capital.
items.stemZh: 新規定將在全國適用，而不只是在首都。

items.passageEn: Last month, our town held its first food festival, and it was a big success. The organizers chose the old dock as the venue, because it has plenty of space and a view of the sea. More than fifty booths sold food from all over the country, and some cooks even came from the suburbs of the capital. To keep visitors safe, the main road was closed to cars, so the whole area became a pedestrian zone. Police officers stood at every intersection to guide traffic. The festival even made the nationwide news, and the organizers are already planning next year's event.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們鎮上舉辦了第一屆美食節，非常成功。主辦單位選擇舊碼頭當場地，因為那裡空間很大，又看得到海景。五十多個攤位販賣來自全國各地的美食，有些廚師甚至從首都的郊區前來。為了遊客的安全，主要道路禁止汽車通行，整個區域變成行人徒步區。每個路口都有警察指揮交通。美食節甚至上了全國新聞，主辦單位已經在規劃明年的活動。

questions.questionZh: 主辦單位為什麼選舊碼頭當場地？
為了遊客安全，主辦單位做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 我在郊區長大，每天要坐一小時的車到市區上學。
referenceEn: I grew up in the suburbs and had to travel an hour to school in the city every day.
I grew up in a suburb, so I spent an hour every day getting to school in the city.
rubricZh: suburb 指郊區（例如 in the suburbs、in a suburb）
時態合理即可（例如 grew up、had to）；「坐車」可寫，例如 travel、take the bus 等

items.instructionZh: 用 pedestrian 造一個句子，說說你家附近行人走路的情況。
referenceEn: The street near my home has a wide path for pedestrians.
Pedestrians in my neighborhood have to be careful because cars drive fast.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 pedestrian 或 pedestrians
